outcome: accidental diagnosis of morbidly adherent placenta
cohort: 35 pregnant women with ultrasonographic diagnosis of major degree placenta previa at a tertiary care hospital in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
finding: Major degree placenta previa had an incidence of 0.6% and was associated with increased need for blood transfusions, cesarean hysterectomies, and uterine packing, though no maternal mortality was observed.
